webSearch.description.zh-CN: Search the web with an LLM provider's built-in web search or a configured Search API. Auto mode prefers LLM search and falls back to API search as configured.
webSearch.description.en-US: Search the web with an LLM provider's built-in web search or a configured Search API. Auto mode prefers LLM search and falls back to API search as configured.

webSearch.query.zh-CN: The search query or question to answer
webSearch.query.en-US: The search query or question to answer

webSearch.mode.zh-CN: Search mode: auto, llm, or api
webSearch.mode.en-US: Search mode: auto, llm, or api

webSearch.provider.zh-CN: API search provider; used as the fallback provider in auto mode
webSearch.provider.en-US: API search provider; used as the fallback provider in auto mode

webSearch.maxResults.zh-CN: Number of API search results, from 1 to 10
webSearch.maxResults.en-US: Number of API search results, from 1 to 10

webSearch.urls.zh-CN: Additional URLs to analyze with model search, up to 20
webSearch.urls.en-US: Additional URLs to analyze with model search, up to 20

webSearch.searchingUrls.zh-CN: 正在搜索并分析 {count} 个 URL…

webSearch.unsupported.zh-CN: 当前或配置的模型不支持 LLM 网络搜索。
webSearch.unsupported.en-US: The current or configured model does not support LLM web search.

webSearch.urlsRequireLlm.zh-CN: API 搜索不支持 urls。请使用 llm 模式、url_context 或 web_fetch。
webSearch.urlsRequireLlm.en-US: API search does not support urls. Use llm mode, url_context, or web_fetch.

webSearch.fallbackFailed.zh-CN: LLM 搜索失败：{llm}；API 回退（{provider}）失败：{api}
webSearch.fallbackFailed.en-US: LLM search failed: {llm}; API fallback ({provider}) failed: {api}

urlContext.description.zh-CN: Analyze up to 20 public URLs with built-in URL Context from Google Gemini Developer API or Vertex Express; public YouTube URLs are handled as video input.
urlContext.description.en-US: Analyze up to 20 public URLs with built-in URL Context from Google Gemini Developer API or Vertex Express; public YouTube URLs are handled as video input.

urlContext.query.zh-CN: Question or task to perform on the URLs
urlContext.query.en-US: Question or task to perform on the URLs

urlContext.urls.zh-CN: Public URLs to analyze, from 1 to 20
urlContext.urls.en-US: Public URLs to analyze, from 1 to 20

urlContext.unsupported.zh-CN: url_context 需要 Google Gemini Developer API 或 Vertex Express 模型。当前模型：{model}。
urlContext.unsupported.en-US: url_context requires a Google Gemini Developer API or Vertex Express model. Current model: {model}.

urlContext.unverified.zh-CN: 提供商 {provider} 未返回已验证的 URL Context 元数据；除非工具详情中包含来源或已获取 URL，否则请将回答视为未溯源。
urlContext.unverified.en-US: Provider {provider} returned no verified URL Context metadata. Treat the answer as ungrounded unless tool details contain sources or retrieved URLs.

urlContext.singleYouTube.zh-CN: Gemini 每次请求只支持一个公开 YouTube URL。请分别调用 url_context。
urlContext.singleYouTube.en-US: Gemini supports only one public YouTube URL per request. Call url_context separately for each video.

output.moreResults.zh-CN: 工具详情中还有 {count} 条结果。
output.moreResults.en-US: There are {count} more results in tool details.

provider.error.missingCredential.zh-CN: 未配置 {env}。请运行 /config:web-search，或导出该环境变量。
provider.error.missingCredential.en-US: {env} is not configured. Run /config:web-search or export the environment variable.

provider.error.emptyFetch.zh-CN: {provider} 抓取 API 没有返回 {url} 的正文。
provider.error.emptyFetch.en-US: {provider} Fetch API returned no content for {url}.

provider.error.invalidBaseProtocol.zh-CN: {env} 必须使用 http:// 或 https://，不能使用 {protocol}://。
provider.error.invalidBaseProtocol.en-US: {env} must use http:// or https://, not {protocol}://.

provider.error.missingBaseUrl.zh-CN: 未配置 {env}。请运行 /config:web-search，或导出该环境变量。
provider.error.missingBaseUrl.en-US: {env} is not configured. Run /config:web-search or export the environment variable.

provider.error.connectionRefused.zh-CN: 无法连接 {host} 上的 {provider}。请确认服务正在运行。
provider.error.connectionRefused.en-US: Could not connect to {provider} at {host}. Make sure the service is running.

provider.hint.searxngAuth.zh-CN: （SearXNG 反向代理拒绝了 Bearer token；请检查 SEARXNG_API_KEY 或 api.apiKeys.searxng）
provider.hint.searxngAuth.en-US: (the SearXNG reverse proxy rejected the Bearer token; check SEARXNG_API_KEY or api.apiKeys.searxng)

provider.hint.searxngJson.zh-CN: （SearXNG 可能未启用 JSON 输出；请在 settings.yml 的 search.formats 中启用 json）
provider.hint.searxngJson.en-US: (the SearXNG instance may have JSON output disabled; enable json under search.formats in settings.yml)

provider.hint.ollamaAuth.zh-CN: （请运行 ollama signin 完成鉴权）

provider.hint.ollamaUnsupported.zh-CN: （该 Ollama 实例可能不支持网络搜索；请升级到较新版本）
provider.hint.ollamaUnsupported.en-US: (the Ollama instance may not support web search; use a recent version)

webFetch.description.zh-CN: Read one HTTP(S) URL and return its content through a hosted fetch provider or built-in HTML-to-text extraction.
webFetch.description.en-US: Read one HTTP(S) URL and return its content through a hosted fetch provider or built-in HTML-to-text extraction.

webFetch.raw.zh-CN: Return the raw response body when using built-in HTTP fetch
webFetch.raw.en-US: Return the raw response body when using built-in HTTP fetch

webFetch.truncated.zh-CN: 内容已截断；完整内容保存到：{path}
webFetch.truncated.en-US: Content was truncated; full content saved to: {path}

error.unsupportedContentType.zh-CN: 不支持内容类型 {contentType}；web_fetch 只支持文本页面。
error.unsupportedContentType.en-US: Unsupported content type: {contentType}. web_fetch supports text pages only.

error.redirectWithoutLocation.zh-CN: {url} 返回重定向，但没有 Location 响应头。

error.tooManyRedirects.zh-CN: 读取 {url} 时重定向次数过多。

error.responseTooLarge.zh-CN: 响应正文超过 {maxBytes} 字节。

error.unknownApiProvider.zh-CN: 未知 API 搜索提供商：{provider}

error.urlCredentials.zh-CN: web_fetch 不支持 URL 中携带用户名或密码。
error.urlCredentials.en-US: Credentials in fetched URLs are not supported.

error.privateAddress.zh-CN: 拒绝读取私网或回环地址：{host}

error.noDnsAddress.zh-CN: 未找到 {host} 的 DNS 地址。

error.privateDnsAddress.zh-CN: 拒绝读取 {host}：DNS 解析到了私网或回环地址 {address}。
error.privateDnsAddress.en-US: Refusing to fetch {host}: DNS resolved to private/loopback address {address}.

config.mode.zh-CN: mode 必须是 auto、llm 或 api。
config.mode.en-US: mode must be auto, llm, or api.

config.transport.zh-CN: llm.transport 必须是 auto、google-developer 或 vertex-express。
config.transport.en-US: llm.transport must be auto, google-developer, or vertex-express.

llm.noPrompt.zh-CN: 请求正文中没有提示文本。
llm.noPrompt.en-US: No prompt text was found in the request body.

llm.unsupportedProvider.zh-CN: 提供商不支持 LLM 网络搜索：{provider}（{api}）
llm.unsupportedProvider.en-US: Provider does not support LLM web search: {provider} ({api})

llm.unsupportedGoogleProvider.zh-CN: 不支持 Google 提供商：{provider}

llm.authFailed.zh-CN: 无法获取 API 密钥或鉴权请求头。
llm.authFailed.en-US: Failed to get API key and authentication headers.

llm.searchingProvider.zh-CN: 正在使用 {provider} 搜索网络…

llm.codexInstruction.zh-CN: Answer the user's request using web search when needed.
llm.codexInstruction.en-US: Answer the user's request using web search when needed.

llm.claudeCodeSystem.zh-CN: You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.
llm.claudeCodeSystem.en-US: You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.

llm.codexCredential.zh-CN: openai-codex 模型未配置 OAuth 凭证。
llm.codexCredential.en-US: No OAuth credential is configured for the openai-codex model.

llm.codexAccount.zh-CN: openai-codex 凭证中没有 ChatGPT account ID。
llm.codexAccount.en-US: No ChatGPT account ID is configured for the openai-codex model.

llm.codexAccountExtract.zh-CN: 无法从 openai-codex 凭证提取 ChatGPT account ID。
llm.codexAccountExtract.en-US: Failed to extract the ChatGPT account ID from openai-codex credentials.

configPanel.commandDescription.zh-CN: 打开网络搜索配置面板
configPanel.commandDescription.en-US: Open the web search configuration panel

configPanel.llmModelTitle.zh-CN: 选择 LLM 搜索模型

configPanel.apiProviderTitle.zh-CN: 选择 Search API 提供商

configPanel.fallbackTitle.zh-CN: 选择 auto 模式允许回退的错误；完成后返回
configPanel.fallbackTitle.en-US: Select errors that may fall back in auto mode, then choose Done

configPanel.mode.auto.zh-CN: Auto：先 LLM，按规则回退 API
configPanel.mode.auto.en-US: Auto: LLM first, then configured API fallback

configPanel.mode.llm.en-US: LLM: model built-in web search only

configPanel.secretKeepOrClear.zh-CN: 输入新值；留空保留 {masked}；输入 {clear} 清除
configPanel.secretKeepOrClear.en-US: Enter a new value; leave empty to keep {masked}; enter {clear} to clear

configPanel.secretEnterOrSkip.zh-CN: 输入 API key；留空不修改；输入 {clear} 清除
configPanel.secretEnterOrSkip.en-US: Enter an API key; leave empty unchanged; enter {clear} to clear

configPanel.valueKeepOrClear.zh-CN: 输入新地址；留空保留 {value}；输入 {clear} 清除
configPanel.valueKeepOrClear.en-US: Enter a new URL; leave empty to keep {value}; enter {clear} to clear

configPanel.baseUrlDefault.zh-CN: 输入地址；留空不修改；默认 {value}；输入 {clear} 清除
configPanel.baseUrlDefault.en-US: Enter a URL; leave empty unchanged; default {value}; enter {clear} to clear

configPanel.loadFailed.zh-CN: 读取网络搜索配置失败：{error}
configPanel.loadFailed.en-US: Failed to load web search configuration: {error}

configPanel.saved.zh-CN: 网络搜索配置已保存到 {path}。

configPanel.providerEnvOverride.zh-CN: 环境变量正在把 API provider 覆盖为 {provider}；面板保存的 provider 会在移除该环境变量后生效。
configPanel.providerEnvOverride.en-US: An environment variable currently overrides the API provider with {provider}; the panel selection takes effect after that variable is removed.

config.positiveNumber.zh-CN: {label} 必须是大于 0 的数字。
config.positiveNumber.en-US: {label} must be a number greater than 0.

github.ghHint.zh-CN: [pi-web-search] 安装 `gh` CLI 可更好地访问 GitHub 仓库，包括私有仓库。
github.ghHint.en-US: [pi-web-search] Install the `gh` CLI for better GitHub repository access, including private repositories.

github.apiOnly.zh-CN: 这是仅 API 视图。若需深入浏览，请克隆仓库或使用 `read`/`bash`。
github.apiOnly.en-US: This is an API-only view. Clone the repository or use `read`/`bash` for deeper exploration.

github.shaApiNote.zh-CN: 注意：commit SHA URL 使用 GitHub API，而不是克隆。
github.shaApiNote.en-US: Note: Commit SHA URLs use the GitHub API instead of cloning.

github.largeRepoNote.zh-CN: 注意：仓库大小为 {size}MB（阈值：{threshold}MB）。将显示 API 获取的内容，而不是完整克隆。如需完整克隆，请再次使用相同 URL 调用 web_fetch。
github.largeRepoNote.en-US: Note: Repository is {size}MB (threshold: {threshold}MB). Showing API-fetched content instead of a full clone. To clone the full repository, call web_fetch again with the same URL.

github.explore.zh-CN: 使用上方路径配合 `read` 和 `bash` 工具继续浏览。
github.explore.en-US: Use the `read` and `bash` tools at the path above to explore further.

github.pathNotFound.zh-CN: 克隆中未找到路径 `{path}`，改为显示仓库根目录。
github.pathNotFound.en-US: Path `{path}` was not found in the clone. Showing the repository root instead.

github.binaryFile.zh-CN: 二进制文件（{extension}，{size}）。请使用上方路径配合 `read` 或 `bash` 检查。
github.binaryFile.en-US: Binary file ({extension}, {size}). Use `read` or `bash` at the path above to inspect it.

github.readFailed.zh-CN: 无法将 `{path}` 作为 UTF-8 文本读取。
github.readFailed.en-US: Could not read `{path}` as UTF-8 text.

github.fullFile.zh-CN: [文件已截断到 100K 字符。完整文件：{path}]

github.unsafeClonePath.zh-CN: 拒绝使用超出 GitHub 克隆根目录的路径。
github.unsafeClonePath.en-US: Refusing to use a path outside the GitHub clone root.
